'''''Valley View''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a valley at an unknown location.

==Behind the scenes==
''Valley view'' can be either looted via the loot system or crafted.
